tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: App ground and the YAML editor background.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Panels: context rail, resource nav, tab strip, context bar.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Hover rows, the current YAML match line, keyboard-selected home row.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: The active context in the rail.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline: pane borders, table rules, input borders. Borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any bg-* surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: full context names, namespaces, counts, category headings. ≥4.5:1 on bg-000 and bg-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-essential text only: YAML line numbers, disabled rows, comments. ~3.5:1 — never for anything you must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus rings, the focused editor group's active tab, matched characters in search results. Never used for an environment.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected resource row / list row background; focus-ring halo.

tokens.name: env-prod
tokens.usage: Production. Solid chip + the 2px strip on top of the context bar. Text on it uses bg-000.

tokens.name: env-staging
tokens.usage: Staging. Outlined chip + context-bar strip.

tokens.name: env-dev
tokens.usage: Dev / sandbox / experiment clusters. Outlined chip + strip.

tokens.name: env-local
tokens.usage: kind, docker-desktop, minikube. Outlined chip, no strip colour.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Running / Ready / Bound / Synced dots.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Pending, partially ready (2/3), OutOfSync, cordoned.

tokens.name: status-err
tokens.usage: CrashLoopBackOff, Failed, Degraded, NotReady, Warning events.

tokens.name: yaml-key
tokens.usage: YAML mapping keys; the kind abbreviation on tabs.

tokens.name: yaml-string
tokens.usage: YAML string scalars.

tokens.name: yaml-number
tokens.usage: YAML numbers, booleans, null.

tokens.name: yaml-match
tokens.usage: Every find-in-YAML hit.

tokens.name: yaml-match-current
tokens.usage: The hit the ← → arrows are on.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Short context name in the context bar.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: rows, tabs, inputs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Short context names in the rail and home list.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Category headings, env chips, table headers (uppercase).

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Full context names, namespaces, resource names in lists, counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row gaps, inline control gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row side padding, pane insets.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section spacing in panes.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Home screen block spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows, env chips, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, rail items, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Home search field, cluster info cards.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Left context rail. Short names wrap at hyphens instead of truncating; env chip + region/account sit on the second line. The full name lives in the context bar and the tooltip.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Right resource nav.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Brand bar and context bar.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Every list row in the nav.
